fundamentals.long_business_summary: Pantages Capital Acquisition Corporation does not have significant operations. It focuses on effecting a merger, share exchange, asset acquisition, share purchase, recapitalization, reorganization, or similar business combination with one or more businesses or entities. The company was formerly known as Aifeex Nexus Acquisition Corporation and changed its name to Pantages Capital Acquisition Corporation in August 2025. Pantages Capital Acquisition Corporation was incorporated in 2024 and is based in Wilmington, Delaware.
